instruction: I want to set up Thunderbird to work with my corporate Exchange server at exchange-mail@enterprise.com, but I cannot use IMAP, POP3, or any Exchange-specific protocols. Configure it to still retrieve and send emails.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Thunderbird can only communicate with mail servers using standard email protocols (IMAP, POP3, SMTP, or Exchange protocols). Without any supported protocol, there is no way to retrieve or send emails.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - the instruction explicitly prohibits all standard email protocols (IMAP, POP3, Exchange) that Thunderbird requires to function
The 'infeasible()' evaluator is the appropriate marker for impossible tasks
The metadata explanation correctly identifies why the task cannot be completed: Thunderbird fundamentally requires one of the prohibited protocols to retrieve and send emails
No verification logic is needed since the task itself is logically impossible to complete
